structural_change: S81-GUNIT whole model (10-19, FANOUT_SAFE 1 + CONTROL_SAFE 1 + Q4 1, LEAD-S81 approved): base table 3,072 b -> 12 native ot_sram_1r1w2c_32x64_m1 banks (registered read = old bases capture, 0 edges; selected-word write-before-launch = sticky fault); kept same-edge copies for every >32-load driver (mapped census 3ca0d8055); regional reset ot_rst_region16 (raw port -> 2 sync flops, 16 kept roots, release edge 3); Q4 fault/range stage (+40 HC edges, priced to the compiler: HC offsets remeasured with run_gu_bench.sh). Outline 388.8 x 432 (was 259.2^2). S81-SAFE-FIX/GUNIT (10-19, SAFE-DESIGN review after the first route dsdv_gunit_l5-g3-37cf95cf2): the tail's Sinkhorn is ot_hdc_sinkhorn_p -- bit-identical, PIPELINED on the core clock (11 registered stages a normalisation, <= ~20 levels each; step 0 in 12) -- replacing ot_hdc_sinkhorn behind an ICG with a 9-cycle multicycle SDC (gunit_sinkh_mcp.sdc, 138 levels / ~5.3 ns in one reg->reg stage: masked depth); the ICG and the multicycle exception are gone; HC result +55 edges (handed to MU-DIE-S81). The table select tj_set/tj_w (3,456 loads) is replicated in two kept ranks (8 -> 108 copies, <= ~32 loads, 0 edges: stable from mix_go). reset_landing 2, io_hold_margin 0.03. S81U-GUNIT6 (10-17): native pin rules -- rst_n drives only ot_rst_relay (0 data edges). S81U-GUNIT3 (10-17): dsdv_gunit_l5 successor: the tail's exp / fdiv units (11.5k flops) moved to the E-side leaf dsdv_gunit_l5f (GUNIT2 L5: 23,268 sinks, TT insertion 563 ps / spread 109 ps, clock-rule FAIL); the row max is a 2-stage tree (one-cycle 3-deep scan was TT -970 ps); the Sinkhorn ICG enable is a flop, not the rst_n port (in->ICG -345 ps). Tail calendar re-derived (XS 3, MAX +1): bit-exact bench. The mixes arrive one a cycle and are assembled here (launch +1 edge).
